تدوفعت (form VI)
# تُدُوفِعْتُ (tudūfiʕtu) /tu.duː.fiʕ.tu/: first-person singular past passive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تُدُوفِعْتَ (tudūfiʕta) /tu.duː.fiʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تُدُوفِعْتِ (tudūfiʕti) /tu.duː.fiʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# تُدُوفِعَتْ (tudūfiʕat) /tu.duː.fi.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
